record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PSYBEAM: Staryu (1 star) and Starmie (2 stars); both range 2, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the damage and confusion-duration tables. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs a target (inherited requiresTarget = true). Fires a line from the caster through the cast target to the board edge (effectInLine: supercover cells from the caster's cell toward a point 12 cells away along the caster-to-target angle). Every enemy-team entity on those cells takes requested SPECIAL damage 25 (1 star) / 50 (2 stars) (table 25 / 50 / 100 / 200, 200 as fallback) through handleSpecialDamage with the caster as attacker and the cast's crit flag (crit needs ABILITY_CRIT), then an independent 50% roll (luck-adjusted: p^(1 - luck/100)) triggers confusion of 2000 ms (1 star) / 3000 ms (2 stars) (table 2000 / 3000 / 4000 / 5000, 5000 as fallback) on that enemy. The roll and triggerConfusion happen for every enemy on the line even when the damage was blocked by protect / skydiving / Magic Bounce. triggerConfusion is called without apBoost, so AP does not scale the duration; it does nothing on an already confused enemy, with Rune Protect or IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; sandstorm weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then SWIFT_SWIM / HYDRATION / WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER and Odd Keystone reductions apply; a Persim Berry holder eats the berry (clears confusion, immunity, heal 50, +10 special defense).

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the line cells; allies and the caster's own cell are skipped by the team filter
targeting.note: The target only fixes the line's angle; it is hit only if its cell lies on the computed line (effectInLine has no fallback that touches the original target). Enemies behind the target are hit too.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster through the cast target to the board edge; every touched cell counts, diagonal crossings included

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] ?? 200. handleSpecialDamage multiplies by (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT, and on a crit by 1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction factor (Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite). Crit needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers, handed to PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef of the target), rounded up with a minimum of 1, absorbed first by the target's shield. takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current HP; 0 when the target is protected / skydiving / Magic Bounce. Requested, applied and takenDamage are three different amounts. Damage is requested once per enemy on the line.

statusEffects.target: each enemy on the line, per independent roll
statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit (apBoost not passed). The chance is chance(0.5, caster): effective probability = 0.5^(1 - luck/100) capped at 1, so luck above 0 raises it.
statusEffects.resolution: triggerConfusion does nothing if the enemy is already confused, has Rune Protect (status.runeProtect) or IMMUNITY_CONFUSION. Otherwise duration x1.3 in SANDSTORM, then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 (else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3), then -10% per Odd Keystone of the enemy's player, rounded; confusion = true and confusionCooldown = that value. Persim Berry holders eat the berry (confusion cleared at once), a PSYDUCK-passive target gains +100 AP. updateConfusion clears the flag and the unit's target when the cooldown runs out. The roll happens even when the damage was blocked by protect. Requested duration vs applied: the table value is the request, the stored cooldown is the result after the weather and reductions.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars. 100 / 200 damage and 4000 / 5000 ms are not reached by the listed units at their factory star counts. Whether other mechanics change a unit's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates (angle rounding of the line end point). Range 2 only governs when the unit casts; the line itself extends to the board edge.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast rolls every enemy on the line independently; an enemy already confused is not re-confused (no refresh).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 25 / 50 (STARYU / STARMIE) and confusion 2000 / 3000 ms with chance 0.5. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) x DOUBLE_DAMAGE x steam x crit factor; applied damage after speDef, minimum 1 and shield; takenDamage = shield + HP part. Confusion duration is requested raw, then stored after weather, status reductions and Odd Keystones; AP does not change it.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read
How a confused unit targets and attacks (getTargetWhenConfused, random orientation) was not re-traced here; see the CONFUSION candidate
unresolved: Whether the cast target is always on the computed line (effectInLine has no fallback to touch it; angle rounding was not exercised)
Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value (evolution, merging) was not examined
Persim Berry and PSYDUCK-passive side effects were read from triggerConfusion / eatBerry only; their downstream stat effects were not traced
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
